articles.title: Malaysia May Widen Ban on Israel-Based Waze Traffic App, PM Says
articles.description: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Malaysia’s security cannot be compromised as he held fast on the government’s partial ban of Google’s navigation app Waze and said authorities aren’t ruling out even wider restrictions.
